messages:
alex.kim: quick handoff — i'm wrapping my shift. primary for next 8h: @maria.lopez (eu-west). secondary: @sasha.rivera (us-east). active page: INC-823 (embeddings latency spike). brief notes:

alex.kim: timeline: 00:12 UTC we saw 3x latency increase for /v1/embeddings. traffic concentrated in eu-west1. load spiky around 80 requests/s.

alex.kim: mitigation taken during my shift:
- scaled down batch_size from 32 -> 8
- enabled fallback routing to `embed-small-v2` for low-priority tenants
- disabled per-customer KV prefetch for affected pool
- opened status page (https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-823)

maria.lopez: ack, thanks alex. i'm on. can you drop the exact commands you used to switch the routing? will validate metrics for the next 30m.

alex.kim: sure — command I ran:
```
# switch routing policy for eu-west embeddings pool
redwoodctl routing set --pool eu-west-embeddings --variant embed-small-v2 --weight 100
```

alex.kim: also added a temporary alert to monitor 95p token-latency > 800ms for 5m.

deploy-bot: Incident INC-823: routing change applied by alex.kim at 2172509500. Ping: @maria.lopez

sasha.rivera: noted. i'll keep an eye on kv-cache thrash metrics — saw a small bump in miss rate earlier. If it rises, i'll evict largest prefixes from cache until stable.

maria.lopez: looked at current dashboards — p95 for embeddings in eu-west down from 1200ms -> ~420ms after the switch. throughput dropped ~20% which matches smaller batch sizing. Customer impact: app A (cust-847) saw elevated error rate earlier but errors are now within SLOs. i've messaged support to update customers.

maria.lopez: filing follow-up ticket for permanent fix and tuning.

maria.lopez: created JIRA: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-1124 — title: "Investigate eu-west embeddings latency spikes; add permanent routing policy" — assigned to @sasha.rivera. please update ETA.

sasha.rivera: ACK on ENG-1124. i'll start with KV cache heatmap and per-tenant request distribution. ETA EOW for initial findings.

alex.kim: action items from handoff:
1) add runbook section `embeddings/latency-spike` with run scenarios + commands (owner: sasha.rivera)
2) add synthetic monitor for eu-west embedding p95 (owner: maria.lopez)
3) schedule retro with infra + runtime teams (owner: alex.kim)
4) add fallback weight automation for sustained high-latency periods (owner: eng-runtime)

maria.lopez: i'll take #2. linking runbook proto: https://wiki.redwood.ai/runbooks/embeddings

sasha.rivera: taking #1; will create a PR against ops-runbooks by tomorrow.

alex.kim: i scheduled a short retro: Wed 10:00 AM PDT — invite sent to #eng-runtime, #eng-platform, #eng-ml. agenda: root cause hypotheses, runbook gaps, automated mitigation.

maria.lopez: one more note — coverage gap: the next on-call (overnight UTC window) is light on eu-west presence (only one engineer). recommend short overlap with eu morning that week. @oncall-bot can we add a reminder 1h before shift if no overlap is scheduled?

oncall-bot: reminder rule created: "eu-west overlap check" — will ping #eng-oncall 1h before handoff if no overlap detected.

sasha.rivera: filed a lightweight follow-up ticket for cache evict script tuning: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-1125 — triage -> P2.

maria.lopez: support message posted to customers impacted (cust-847, cust-909). template used includes incident link + mitigation steps. support thread: https://support.redwood.ai/t/cust-847/inc-823

alex.kim: leaving detailed logs snippet here for whoever picks this up:
```
2026-03-14T00:11:23Z eu-west-embeddings pool: p95 1213ms p50 210ms req/s 82
2026-03-14T00:12:00Z applied routing change -> embed-small-v2
2026-03-14T00:13:00Z eu-west-embeddings pool: p95 421ms p50 190ms req/s 66
```

maria.lopez: any outstanding asks before I take full ownership?

sasha.rivera: nothing blocking. i'll post status updates every 30m for the next 2 hours. ping me in thread if thresholds cross.

maria.lopez: thanks all — taking primary. leaving handoff note in rotation doc.

alex.kim: thanks team, enjoy the rest of the day. :v:

sasha.rivera: :eyes: will follow up on ENG-1124 and ENG-1125.

oncall-bot: Handoff complete: primary set -> maria.lopez; secondary -> sasha.rivera; handoff_ts: 2172509999
